claims: Tiger Woods is second all-time in Masters Tournament wins behind Jack Nicklaus.
Jack Nicklaus has six Masters wins.
Tiger Woods was age 21 when he won the 1997 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods became the youngest Masters champion ever in 1997.
Tiger Woods won the 1997 Masters Tournament by a record margin of 12 strokes.
Tiger Woods secured his second green jacket in 2001.
Tiger Woods completed the "Tiger Slam" in 2001.
Tiger Woods became the only golfer to hold all four professional major titles simultaneously in 2001.
Tiger Woods successfully defended his Masters Tournament title in 2002.
Tiger Woods won the Masters Tournament back-to-back in 2002.
Tiger Woods won his fourth green jacket in a playoff against Chris DiMarco in 2005.
Tiger Woods won his fifth Masters Tournament in 2019.
Tiger Woods' 2019 Masters Tournament win was his first major victory in 11 years.
Tiger Woods has recorded 14 top-10 finishes in 20 professional appearances at Augusta National.
